name: Idiopathic Pulmonary Hemosiderosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No standardized formal criteria; diagnosis of exclusion

criteria.description: Evidence of recurrent or chronic alveolar hemorrhage confirmed by bronchoalveolar lavage or lung biopsy
Presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in sputum, bronchoalveolar lavage, or lung tissue
Exclusion of other causes of pulmonary hemorrhage such as vasculitis, autoimmune diseases, or cardiac causes
Iron-deficiency anemia secondary to chronic blood loss
Diffuse alveolar infiltrates on chest imaging during hemorrhagic episodes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of recurrent alveolar hemorrhage with hemosiderin-laden macrophages and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by laboratory and imaging findings; lung biopsy may be required in uncertain cases

pathognomonic.notes: Episodes of bleeding into alveolar spaces
Coughing up blood during hemorrhagic episodes
Due to chronic blood loss from alveolar hemorrhage

common.notes: Shortness of breath during physical activity
Secondary to anemia and chronic illness
Non-productive or productive during hemorrhagic episodes

occasional.notes: May occur during acute hemorrhagic episodes

laboratory: Iron-deficiency anemia with low serum ferritin
Presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
imaging: Diffuse bilateral alveolar infiltrates on chest X-ray during hemorrhagic episodes
Ground-glass opacities on high-resolution CT scan
genetic: No known specific genetic mutations identified
other: Lung biopsy showing alveolar hemorrhage and hemosiderin deposits without vasculitis

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of anti-glomerular basement membrane antibodies
Positive ANA and other lupus serologies
Multisystem involvement including skin and joints

redFlags: Development of pulmonary fibrosis with cor pulmonale
references: Kiper N, et al. Idiopathic pulmonary hemosiderosis: a review. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2020;15(1):45.
Ioachimescu OC, et al. Idiopathic pulmonary hemosiderosis revisited. Eur Respir J. 2004;24(1):162-70.
Lachmann HJ, et al. Pulmonary hemorrhage and hemosiderosis. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2011;6:10.
